SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. S. B. REGISTRY
File No. N. D 4761
SECTION D. 2
Date April 25, 1933

REPORT

Subject (in full) Departure of A.P.Turin, Soviet Official.

Made by D.S.Prokofiev. Forwarded by

A.P.Turin, engineer attached to the Trade Representation
of the U.S.S.R. in Japan ( File D.4761 ) left Shanghai for Kobe
on April 25, 1933 by the s.s. " Nagasaki Maru".
Efforts made with a view to locating his address in
Shanghai have proved unsuccessful. It is believed that he resided
with V.G. Platoff, Manager of the Shipping Department, Chinese Eastern
Railway, in Apartment 204, Dubail Apartments, Rue Lafayette.

yR
G. Prokofiev
D.S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Copies of reports sent to Mr. B.
J.B. 2/4
File 9/6

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别科登记处
档案编号 N. D 4761
D 科 2 股
日期 1933年4月25日

报告

事由（全称）苏联官员 A.P. Turin 离境。

呈报人 D.S. Prokofiev。转呈人

A.P. Turin，系附属于苏联驻日本贸易代表处的工程师（档案 D.4761），于1933年4月25日乘坐“长崎丸”号轮船离开上海前往神户。
为查明其在沪住址所作的努力均未成功。据信，他与中东铁路航运部经理 V.G. Platoff 同住于霞飞路 Dubail 公寓 204 室。

yR
G. Prokofiev
D.S.

特别科主管警官。

报告副本已送交 B 先生。
J.B. 2/4
归档 9/6

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. S. Fire Dept.
No. D 4761
SECTION 2 Station
Date 12 / 4 / 33
Date April 12, 1933

Subject (in full) Arrival of A.P. Turin, Soviet Official.

Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by [Signature] O.I.

A.P. Turin, 46, Soviet citizen arrived in Shanghai from
Japan on April 11, 1933 by the s.s. " President Monroe".

He is in possession of service passport No 7223 issued
by the People's Commissariat of Foreign Affairs on May 4, 1931 and
vised by the Chinese Consulate at Yokohama on April 4, 1933.

Turin states that he is a consulting engineer specialis
ing in shipbuilding, attached to the Trade Representation of the
U.S.S.R. in Japan. He gave his address in Tokyo as Uchi-Saiwaicho
Osaka Building.

He intends to stay in Shanghai for about a fortnight,
after which he will return to Tokyo.

y/2
" His address in Shanghai has not yet been located.
G. Prokofiev
D.S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

S2. Please report again when
located.
[Signature]
APR 12 '33

上海公共租界工部局警务处
中央情报科 消防处
编号 D 4761
第2分局
日期 12 / 4 / 33
日期 1933年4月12日

事由（全称）苏联官员 A.P. Turin 抵境。

呈报人 D.S. Prokofiev 转呈人 [签名] O.I.

A.P. Turin，46岁，苏联公民，于1933年4月11日乘坐“门罗总统”号轮船从日本抵达上海。

他持有由外交人民委员部于1931年5月4日签发的第7223号公务护照，并于1933年4月4日经中国驻横滨领事馆签证。

Turin 称其是一名专攻造船业的咨询工程师，附属于苏联驻日本贸易代表处。他提供的东京住址为内幸町大阪大厦。

他打算在上海停留约两周，之后将返回东京。
